summary: Mag Magna Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with CFI Capital, issuing a $170,000 convertible redeemable note with a 6% coupon and conversion price at 60% of the lowest traded price over 20 days. The filing covers standard debt financing terms, prepayment options, and default remedies. No special situation is present; this is a routine capital-raising transaction via a convertible note with no merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The event is a financing agreement, not a strategic change or extraordinary corporate action.
